name: The Escape
summary: You help Wizzlecrank flee the Venture Company drill site at the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens. Trapped in a stolen prototype shredder, the goblin pilot needs protection from company mercenaries as he climbs from the industrial pit. Afterward, you report to his contact, Sputtervalve, in Ratchet.

sections.title: A Clumsy Getaway
sections.body: Wizzlecrank struggles to control the stolen shredder at the Sludge Fen. He has lit the prototype deep inside the Venture Company drill site, but knows little of its levers and switches. The heavy machine lurches across the muddy quarry floor, and its erratic driving and roaring joints alert nearby laborers and armed guards. A stealthy escape becomes a running battle up the excavation pit’s western ramp.

sections.title: Venture Company Pursuit
sections.body: The Venture Company sends mercenaries to stop the stolen prototype. As the machine claws up the slope toward open ground, squads move to intercept and disable it. The shredder lashes out, but cannot withstand their sabotage without your protection. It clears the rim and staggers from the main drilling depression, though the machine soon suffers a critical failure.

sections.title: Salvage and Payoff
sections.body: Wizzlecrank escapes the wrecked prototype shredder alive. Once clear of immediate danger, the machine breaks down and collapses on the savanna turf. Wizzlecrank scrambles out and tells you to report to Sputtervalve in Ratchet while he stays with the wreckage. Eager to study the Venture Company's designs before his opportunity closes, Sputtervalve immediately sends a goblin salvage squad to haul the intact mechanisms back to port.

faq.q: Who is Wizzlecrank and why is he inside a shredder?
faq.answer: Wizzlecrank is an operative and mechanic working with Sputtervalve in Ratchet. He entered the Venture Company's northern drill site to steal its latest experimental shredder prototype, then became trapped while learning its unfamiliar cockpit controls.

faq.q: Where does this escape take place?
faq.answer: The escape begins deep inside the Sludge Fen, a fouled industrial drilling site run by the Venture Company in the northern Barrens, just north of the dry savanna basin.

faq.q: Do you have to escort the shredder all the way to Ratchet?
faq.answer: No. You escort Wizzlecrank out of the drill pit depression and up the western ramp. Once clear of the quarry rim, the machine breaks down, and Wizzlecrank tells you to report to Ratchet on your own.

Sputtervalve is a goblin technician stationed near Ratchet's docks. He gathers industrial intelligence against the rival Venture Company and seeks its mechanical designs to profit from its technological innovations.

faq.q: Why does the shredder fall over at the end?
faq.answer: Wizzlecrank barely knows the controls, and the experimental machine is pushed to its limits in the ambush. It suffers severe mechanical strain breaking through the perimeter, then gives out as soon as it clears the drill site.

faq.q: What happens after the prototype crashes?
faq.answer: Wizzlecrank stays with the downed machine while you report to Sputtervalve in Ratchet. Sputtervalve immediately prepares a goblin salvage team to harvest the prototype's valuable components before the Venture Company can reclaim them.

angles.text: The prototype shredder shows Venture Company pneumatics and cockpit designs, giving engineers valuable insight to study in its salvage.
As a gnome, you may recognize Wizzlecrank's willingness to pilot a volatile machine on guesswork. Goblin tinkerers, like gnomish ones, often tinker first and ask questions later.
As a member of the Horde, you can welcome disruption to the Venture Company's polluting oil operations at the Sludge Fen, an eyesore on the Barrens.
